title: refactor: simplify OAuth client demo
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes the canonical PKCE example fully browser-only with direct token exchange and generation.
- Removes the original session/proxy server from the browser example.
- Adds a separate optional account-linking example for apps with existing users and a database.
- Binds single-use OAuth state to the app user and encrypts delegated keys at rest.
- Links both examples from the Scalar BYOP guide.

Tests: Biome, Node syntax checks, Scalar source-link check, static-server smoke test, mock OAuth callback + encrypted persistence + server-side generation.

gist.headline: OAuth sheds its proxy
gist.blurb: The PKCE demo now runs entirely in the browser: authorize, exchange a token, make a generation. For apps with their own users, a second little garden shows how to link accounts and tuck delegated keys away safely.
gist.summary: Simplified the canonical OAuth PKCE demo into a browser-only flow with direct token exchange and generation, while adding a separate account-linking demo that binds single-use state to app users and encrypts delegated keys at rest.
gist.impact: Developers can now copy a smaller browser-only OAuth integration or use the dedicated server-backed example for existing-user account linking with encrypted delegated-key storage.
gist.visual_concept: Depict two friendly OAuth paths growing from the same flowering code plant: a lightweight browser window sending a direct token to a generation canvas, and a small locked garden shed representing server-side account linking and encrypted key storage. Polli should act as a careful guide between the paths, with a tiny keyring accessory; a CRT robot can eagerly hold the browser flow diagram.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel-art garden workshop with two flowering code-plants: a retro browser window directly exchanging a small golden token for a generated picture, beside a tiny warm garden shed with a lock and labeled pixel key box for account linking. Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee with black antennae, oval black eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and rounded translucent light-blue wings, wears a tiny keyring belt while guiding a cheerful CRT-head robot between the two paths; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream flowers, with subtle pixel text “PKCE”.
